verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. In both, the white line frame sits empty at the top and all the text is stacked below it, so the framing device has lost its purpose. The orange overlay covers only a band of the photo, leaving a raw, unbranded image at top and bottom. Reading order is jumbled: the 'Tickets available' line sits above 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents', and the credit line is larger than the presenter line. The play icon is oversized and pushed against the bottom-left corner, and a large dark dead area sits above it.
